name: n8n_compose_cutover_20261106
comment: ANCHOR: N8N_COMPOSE_CUTOVER_20261106 — n8n program package 0.1a. The production n8n compose lives in ops/n8n/
with no literal secret, the project name that keeps the existing volumes, and a JSON NODES_EXCLUDE. The cutover
tool's dry run refuses unless the repo compose resolves to the running containers' config hashes; --apply refuses
without a passing dry run and fails unless the active-workflow count is unchanged. Hermetic: a fake docker runner.
